# Caret drafting

Follow [the editorial contract](../../../docs/editorial-contract.md). Choose a structure that fits the brief: narrative, explanation, argument, practical guide or another requested format.

A hook, early value, evidence and useful ending can help; they are not a compulsory five-step arc. Use lists, headings, summaries or reflective questions only when they serve this piece. Do not force shareable blockquotes or periodic re-hooks.

Use concrete details already supported by the author or evidence. Metaphors should clarify, not manufacture an author signature. Protect chosen edits and avoid expanding a small revision into a rewrite.
